ledger.SYMPTOM: Drawing Engine existed but one-off Python/HTML/ReportLab paths produced user-facing work.
ledger.USER_OBSERVED: User repeatedly asked why the engine was built but not used.
ledger.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: All production/preview/user-facing drawing artifacts route through an authorized engine.
ledger.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Local scripts could emit artifacts directly.
ledger.ROOT_CAUSE: Execution authority was attached to documented intent, not to the artifact-producing runtime.
ledger.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Existing gates validated package/content but did not verify producer identity or route provenance.
ledger.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: Signed/structured production authorization bound to engine_id + route + gate receipt.
ledger.QUALITY_IMPACT: Unbounded quality variance and non-reusable output.
ledger.REGRESSION_TEST: Production authorization fails for unregistered producer and any user-facing class.

ledger.SYMPTOM: Rectangular masking intended to remove furniture erased walls/core/entry.
ledger.USER_OBSERVED: Wall/core deletion was found by user.
ledger.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Entourage edits cannot mutate protected geometry.
ledger.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Raster presentation layer had destructive authority over geometry pixels.
ledger.ROOT_CAUSE: No protected-geometry occupancy diff before exposure.
ledger.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Source preservation was a declared rule, not a per-layer mutation capability model.
ledger.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: Layer capability ACL + geometry protection mask + pre-user geometry diff.
ledger.REGRESSION_TEST: Fixture mask overlapping protected wall/core must hard-fail.

ledger.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: AI may affect atmosphere/presentation only unless geometry generation is explicitly authorized.
ledger.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Image generation owned both geometry and presentation in a single opaque transform.
ledger.ROOT_CAUSE: No geometry identity check between source and generated result.
ledger.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: AI layer was not sandboxed below geometry authority.
ledger.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: AI/atmosphere layer must consume immutable geometry overlay and cannot become geometry source.
ledger.REGRESSION_TEST: Any detected structural edge displacement or missing protected component blocks show.

ledger.SYMPTOM: Extensive reference mining yielded generic layouts.
ledger.USER_OBSERVED: User questioned whether references were actually applied.
ledger.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Mined DNA compiles to measurable design tokens and output effects.
ledger.ROOT_CAUSE: No mandatory reference compiler or effect delta test.
ledger.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Method_refs existence was treated as use.
ledger.REGRESSION_TEST: Method with no compiled params/effect evidence hard-fails REFERENCE_EFFECT.

ledger.SYMPTOM: Source-preserving result was treated as presentation enhancement.
ledger.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Fidelity and presentation quality pass independently.
ledger.ROOT_CAUSE: No professional-family comparison or minimum visible delta.
ledger.REGRESSION_TEST: Fidelity PASS + reference/user effect FAIL => NO_SHOW.

ledger.SYMPTOM: User repeatedly detected deleted core/walls, rotation/crop, weak expression.
ledger.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: User approval is for choices, never basic defect discovery.
ledger.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Validation could occur after preview generation/exposure.
ledger.REGRESSION_TEST: Known historical defects injected as fixtures must never reach showable state.

ledger.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Recurring capability is centralized or experiment-only.
ledger.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Fast local completion had no production boundary.
ledger.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: One-off tools were not restricted to EXPERIMENT/DIAGNOSTIC.
ledger.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: artifact_class=EXPERIMENT only for unregistered tools; FINAL/PREVIEW forbidden.
ledger.REGRESSION_TEST: Unregistered script requesting PREVIEW/FINAL must fail.

ledger.SYMPTOM: Newer modified timestamp risked being treated as content change/staleness.
ledger.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Freshness compares content identity/authority, not timestamp alone.
ledger.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Freshness gate lacked content fingerprint semantics.
ledger.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: CONTENT_HASH / semantic fingerprint / explicit revision relation.
ledger.REGRESSION_TEST: Same hash with later mtime remains SAME_CONTENT.

ledger.SYMPTOM: ROAD/SOIL/GROUND inferred from color/topology before verification.
ledger.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Presentation semantics require verified evidence or UNKNOWN.
ledger.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Semantic labeling ran ahead of evidence.
ledger.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Presentation engine accepted inferred labels as styling input.
ledger.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: semantic_state VERIFIED required for material-specific tokens; UNKNOWN remains neutral.
ledger.REGRESSION_TEST: Unverified ROAD cannot receive road-specific style token.

ledger.SYMPTOM: Claims risked exceeding drawing evidence: privacy, daylight, south orientation, penthouse.
ledger.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Every material claim maps to evidence state/source.
ledger.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Narrative generation had weaker gate than numeric facts.
ledger.ROOT_CAUSE: No claim-level support threshold across report prose.
ledger.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Fact gate did not fully govern prose adjectives/conclusions.
ledger.REGRESSION_TEST: Unsupported absolute claim hard-fails; qualified claim needs evidence refs.

ledger.SYMPTOM: Resume can preserve a broken architecture and continue it.
ledger.USER_OBSERVED: System could faithfully resume the wrong method.
ledger.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Resume and retrospective/surgery are distinct modes.
ledger.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Handoff optimized continuity over structural challenge.
ledger.ROOT_CAUSE: No resume-mode selection / architecture health trigger.
ledger.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Recovery index had no mandatory surgery escape hatch.
ledger.REGRESSION_TEST: Three repeated failure classes force SURGERY recommendation/route.

critical_boundary: Repository code can block governed production routes, but cannot by itself prevent a chat/tool host from creating and exposing an out-of-repo artifact. Such artifact must be classified NON_PRODUCTION/UNAUTHORIZED under TAKY; platform-level interception remains unproven.
